title: A new optimism
description: Sculpted curves. Open roads. A world rediscovering the joy of driving.

cars.name: Mercedes-Benz 300 SL Gullwing
cars.description: With its roof-hinged gullwing doors and low-slung silhouette, the 300 SL became one of the defining sports cars of the 1950s. Its tubular spaceframe helped give the coupé its distinctive door arrangement, while a three-litre six-cylinder engine delivered performance to match the dramatic design.

cost.basis: Indicative UK market range for good to excellent standard examples; condition, originality and provenance affect value.

cars.name: Citroën DS 19
cars.description: Unveiled in Paris in 1955, the DS looked like a visitor from the future. Its flowing bodywork and hydropneumatic suspension offered a fresh vision of comfort and engineering. This early DS 19 represents the French innovation that made the model a landmark of post-war motoring.

cost.basis: Indicative UK market range for good to excellent standard examples; condition, originality and provenance affect value.

cars.name: Chevrolet Bel Air
cars.description: Tailfins, a wide chrome grille, and bold two-tone styling made the 1957 Bel Air an enduring symbol of American motoring. Available with Chevrolet’s 283-cubic-inch V8, it combined everyday appeal with the optimism and visual theatre of the decade. Few cars capture the spirit of the American fifties so clearly.

cost.basis: Editorial UK estimate for a roadworthy four-door sedan, informed by a £13,800 July 2026 auction sale and European sedan asking prices. Coupés and convertibles can command more.

cars.name: Porsche 356 1100
cars.description: The early 356 established the rounded shape and lightweight sports-car approach that would become Porsche signatures. German series production began in Stuttgart in 1950. Its compact, rear-mounted flat-four engine and split windscreen give this early coupé a character distinct from the later 356 variants.

cost.basis: Editorial UK estimate for an early steel-bodied split-screen coupé, using a £299,950 asking price for a comparable 1951 Pre-A as context. Exact 1950 1100 data is scarce; this is a comparable-based estimate, not a verified model-specific guide value.

cars.name: Morris Mini-Minor
cars.description: Launched in 1959 alongside the Austin Seven, the Morris Mini-Minor rethought how much car could fit into a small footprint. Alec Issigonis’s transverse engine layout helped make room for passengers in a remarkably compact body. The original Mini became a British design icon and a new reference point for small cars.

cost.basis: Indicative UK market range for good to excellent standard examples; condition, originality and provenance affect value.
